g.text: Reference identifications are evidence, not infallible truth
Each mirror uses the same raw spectrum. Blue: b ions; orange: y ions; gray: unmatched.
20 ppm; charges 1–2; m/z <150 hidden; TIC percentages use the full raw spectrum. MT: methylthio; Ox: oxidation; CAM: carbamidomethyl.
